reader_summary.overview: They're crunchy, tangy, and a staple in sandwiches, burgers, and snack plates worldwide. An pickling originated thousands of years ago, with evidence of cucumbers being pickled in the Tigris Valley as far back as 2030 BC. Throughout history, pickles have been enjoyed by various cultures, with notable figures like Cleopatra and Julius Caesar appreciating their flavor and perceived health benefits.

key_points.text: An pickling originated thousands of years ago, with evidence of cucumbers being pickled in the Tigris Valley as far back as 2030 BC.
This widespread appreciation helped spread pickling techniques across continents, adapting to local ingredients and tastes.
In recent years science has shown that eating pickles are good for you and can increase your athletic performance in many ways.
